journey: Help a visitor understand FST, find the right Malta or Rwanda offering, assemble a reversible service request for human WhatsApp review, or prepare a meeting request for human consent and submission.

suggestions.name: ask_fst_site
suggestions.description: Find relevant FST website information for a visitor question across services, industry packages, professional safeguards, insights, contact, privacy and legal information. Use when the visitor asks what FST offers, how work is handled or where to continue; returns matched excerpts with source paths and does not change the page.
suggestions.why: Visitors need one reliable way to retrieve answers from FST's own published content.

params.name: max_results
params.description: Optional maximum number of matched excerpts to return.

suggestions.name: browse_fst_offerings
suggestions.description: Search FST's current Malta or Rwanda services and industry-package catalogue by need, category or phrase. Use when a visitor wants suitable offerings or starting fees; returns concise matches with IDs, prices, safeguards and catalogue paths and does not change the page.
suggestions.why: Visitors need structured catalogue results instead of having an agent scrape cards from the page.

params.name: jurisdiction
params.description: The FST market whose services and prices apply: mt or rw.

params.name: query
params.description: The service need, category or phrase to search for.

suggestions.name: prepare_fst_service_request
suggestions.description: Select valid FST services or industry packages and open the website's order review. Use when a visitor wants to assemble a non-binding request; returns the itemised selection, displayed starting fees and handoff status. It does not send a WhatsApp message or accept an engagement.
suggestions.why: Visitors need an agent-safe way to prepare the same visible order that the catalogue's Add buttons create.

params.name: replace_selection
params.description: Replace the current selection when true; otherwise extend it.

suggestions.name: prepare_fst_meeting_request
suggestions.description: Fill FST's booking form with proposed meeting details and bring it into view. Use only when a visitor wants to review an appointment request; returns the prepared values and validation notes. It does not create a calendar event or send invitations—the visitor must review consent and submit the form.
suggestions.why: Visitors need help preparing a meeting while privacy consent and external notifications remain human-controlled.

params.name: name
params.description: Visitor name to place in the form.

params.name: email
params.description: Business email to place in the form.

params.name: start
params.description: Requested local start in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm form.
